messages.author: 5da0a091ea993e05
messages.subject: About adding new parameters
parts:
Hi Tam,

I just saw your SWAT calibration tool and I am trying to use it for my projects. I will give you feedback once I become familiar with it.
By the way,  I have developed new modules in the SWAT code and there are many new parameters. So is that possible to include new parameters in your tool?  Since it is open-source, can I do it by myself or do you have to add them for me?
Your help will be greatly appreciated.
Thanks


Kevin

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: About adding new parameters
parts:
HI Kevin,
Thanks you for your interest in this tool. This tool is exactly what you need in case there are new parameters.Could you let me know in which files your new parameters are located
Cheers
Tam

messages.author: 5da0a091ea993e05
messages.subject: Re: About adding new parameters
parts:
Hi Tam,

I have downloaded the SWATshiny-master directly from Github and save it to my drive. 
How to run the app to show the interface?

I tried the following method. The packages were installed, but when I run the second commend, it takes a very long time and it still has not finished yet with the massage showing
"Downloading https://github.com/tamnva/SWATshiny/archive/master.tar.gz"
Do you know why?

 # Install shiny package (skip the first line if you already have shiny installed)
    install.packages("shiny")
    library(shiny)
   
    # Download this SWATshiny app (code + data) to your local machine and run it
    runGitHub("SWATshiny", "tamnva")

Thanks


Kevin

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: About adding new parameters
parts:
Hi Kevin,

Yes this is the case if you used the older version of R. Some packages that this program uses does not support older version of R. The message you cannot see, so If just stop there and show "downloading...." forever

In this case just uninstall R and go to the R website to install the LATEST R version, it will work (It should take 1 or few minutes to get the app interface).
